preconditions.description: The number of test cases is between 1 and 1000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= len(s) <= 50 for s in test_cases)
preconditions.description: Each test case string length is between 1 and 50.

postconditions.description: The number of output lines matches the number of test cases.

postconditions.expression: all(output_line in ['YES', 'NO'] for output_line in output_lines)
postconditions.description: Each output line is either 'YES' or 'NO'.

postconditions.expression: all('YES' * k for k in range(1, 1001)).find(s) != -1 if output_line == 'YES' else 'YES' * k for k in range(1, 1001)).find(s) == -1 for s, output_line in zip(test_cases, output_lines))
postconditions.description: For each test case, 'YES' if the string s is a substring of 'Yes' repeated many times, otherwise 'NO'.
